title: Escalation Packet
description: Structured escalation record generated when a reviewer verdict or gate failure requires human intervention.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the escalation packet was generated.

concerns.description: Concerns that triggered or are relevant to this escalation.

file.description: Relative path to the file containing the concern.

line.description: Line number of the concern (0 if file-level).

severity.description: blocking halts the pipeline; concern routes to auto-fix or escalation.

category.description: mechanical concerns may auto-fix; judgment and uncategorized concerns escalate.

manifest_path.description: Path to the goal manifest file.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of why escalation was triggered and what the human needs to decide.

suggested_next_actions.description: Ordered list of suggested actions the human can take to resolve the escalation.

verdict_path.description: Path to the reviewer-verdict file, if applicable.

diff_envelope_path.description: Path to the diff envelope file for the goal.

spec_path.description: Path to the goal spec file.

worktree_path.description: Path to the git worktree for the goal, if one was created.
